name: Paymob

webhook.algorithm: PARTIALLY VERIFIED — and structurally unusual. Paymob computes HMAC-SHA512 keyed with the dashboard HMAC secret over an ordered concatenation of specific transaction fields (the field list and order differ per callback type), NOT over the raw body. It is delivered as an `hmac` value alongside the callback — query string on the browser 'response' callback, body field on the server-to-server 'processed' callback — NOT in a header. No timestamp. notes: The default PSP for Egypt and the only realistic single integration covering Meeza cards, Egyptian mobile wallets, Fawry cash reference codes and InstaPay together. Egypt is card-thin and cash/wallet-heavy; a card-only Egyptian checkout converts badly.
SDKs: No first-party server SDKs. Community: `paymob` (PyPI), `nafezly/payments` (Composer, multi-gateway incl. Paymob/Fawry/Kashier). Emit direct REST.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Kashier and Fawry in Egypt. Paymob is the broader single integration; Fawry direct is only worth it if cash agents are the primary channel.
Onboarding: application_review. Local entity and documentation required.
